display.purpose: Page-level headings. Appears at most once per view.

title.purpose: Section headings, sidebar group labels, card headings.

body.purpose: All prose and field content. 70ch max-width in text-heavy views.

label.purpose: Metadata: timestamps, stat category names, calendar headers. Uppercase for categories.

shadows.name: ambient-rest
shadows.purpose: Auth page card, floating dropdowns. Present but barely perceptible at rest.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Stat cards on hover. Signals interactivity.

shadows.name: dropdown
shadows.purpose: Entry type dropdown in sidebar. Communicates layer separation.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Default for state transitions: border color, background color, shadow.

motion.name: ease-lift
motion.purpose: Stat card hover scale + shadow. Slower to feel deliberate.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action trigger. Sage fill, surface text. Used for form submissions and primary CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #7A8F5E; color: #FDFEFE; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #6A7D4E; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7A8F5E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions: Sign Out, calendar navigation, cancel. Sage outline, fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: transparent; color: #7A8F5E; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid #7A8F5E; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: #7A8F5E; color: #FDFEFE; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7A8F5E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field. Used for email, password, trade metadata. Focus border shifts to sage.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #6B7368; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-input { background-color: #FDFEFE; color: #1A1E18; border: 1px solid #E4E7E0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.6; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9CA398; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #7A8F5E; }

components.name: Trade Entry Card
components.description: Compact sidebar row for a trade entry. P&L in emerald or red. Hover shifts border to sage.
components.css: .ds-entry-card { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 12px; background-color: #F8F9F6; border: 1px solid #E4E7E0; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-entry-card:hover { border-color: #7A8F5E; background-color: #EEF0EC; } .ds-entry-pnl { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-entry-pnl--win { color: #059669; } .ds-entry-pnl--loss { color: #DC2626; } .ds-entry-date { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; color: #9CA398; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Dashboard overview tile. Four across: Total P&L, Win Rate, Avg Win, Avg Loss. Hover lifts.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { flex: 1; min-width: 160px; background-color: #FDFEFE; border: 1px solid #E4E7E0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-stat-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(26,30,24,0.08), 0 1px 4px rgba(26,30,24,0.05); transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-stat-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #6B7368; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1A1E18; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 0; }

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Left navigation column. Quiet chrome: white surface, gray border, sage new-entry button.
components.html: Entries
components.css: .ds-sidebar { width: 240px; min-width: 240px; background-color: #FDFEFE; border-right: 1px solid #E4E7E0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; } .ds-sidebar-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E4E7E0; } .ds-sidebar-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1A1E18; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-sidebar-add { width: 24px; height: 24px; background-color: #7A8F5E; color: #FDFEFE; border: none; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-sidebar-add:hover { background-color: #6A7D4E; } .ds-sidebar-list { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
A field notebook belongs to a practitioner who takes their work seriously. It is not decorated. It is not designed to impress. It is designed to be used, day after day, until the pages carry the weight of real history. This interface is that notebook: clean pages, honest data, no ornamentation competing with the record.

The visual language is restrained light mode: near-white surfaces with a faint sage tint, sage as the single accent, data colors (emerald and red) reserved strictly for financial outcomes. Whitespace is not empty space but active space; it tells the eye where to look. The sidebar is quiet and present, like a table of contents on a notepad. The content area is where the work happens.

This system explicitly rejects: Bloomberg-style data density; crypto neon aggression; generic SaaS dashboard energy (white and blue-purple, hero metric cards with gradients, identical card grids); traditional finance formality (navy and gold, serif weight).
keyCharacteristics: Light mode, subtle sage tint on all neutral surfaces
Single accent color (sage) used sparingly; data colors are semantic only
Breathing room: consistent generous padding, sparse chrome
Flat-by-default surfaces with soft ambient shadows on hover and floating elements
Typography hierarchy through weight and scale contrast, not color
No decorative elements; every visual element earns its place

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Sage appears on 10% or less of any given screen at rest. Every button, link, and hover state uses it — but surfaces, text, and containers stay neutral. Its scarcity is why it works.

rules.name: The Data Color Rule
rules.body: Emerald and red are reserved for financial outcomes only. No emerald success banners. No red error icons styled to match the P&L red. Data colors carry financial meaning and must not be diluted.

rules.name: The No Display-Font Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a serif or expressive display typeface for notebook feel. The field notebook quality is architectural, not typographic. Adding a serif will push the design toward a lifestyle product aesthetic that conflicts with the tool register.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: At rest, surfaces are differentiated by background tint (surface vs. surface-alt), not by shadow. Shadows appear only when an element lifts on hover or floats above the layout. A shadow at rest is visual noise.

dos: Do use sage (#7A8F5E) as the sole accent for all interactive states: buttons, focus rings, hover borders, active nav items.
Do use emerald and red strictly for financial data: P&L values, calendar day fills, win/loss labels.
Do differentiate surface depth tonally: surface-alt (#F8F9F6) for page backgrounds and entry cards; surface (#FDFEFE) for cards and layered elements.
Do keep the sidebar visually quiet: no background fill variations, no colored section labels, no bold sidebar headers.
Do apply the label scale (0.75rem, 500 weight, uppercase, tracking) for category identifiers and timestamps.
Do use tabular-nums on all currency and percentage values so columns align.
Do cap prose line length at 70ch in the entry editor and any long-form text view.
donts: Don't use blue-600 (#2563EB) anywhere in the interface going forward. It belongs to the generic Tailwind default, not this system.
Don't introduce gradient text, glassmorphism, or glow effects. Zero decorative surface treatments.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left as a colored accent on cards or alerts).
Don't build hero metric displays: big number, label, gradient accent.
Don't color-code anything based on mood or status. Semantic color is reserved for financial data only.
Don't make the sidebar compete for attention. No bold header blocks, no colored backgrounds.
Don't use Bloomberg terminal density, crypto neon styling, navy-and-gold traditional finance patterns, or the blue-purple-gradient SaaS dashboard aesthetic.
